title: Matching Configuration Schema
description: Domain-agnostic configuration for item matching rules, filters, and scoring

maxCandidates.description: Maximum number of matched items to return

filters.description: Dynamic filters applied before scoring. Each key is a field name, value is a filter definition.

operator.description: Comparison operator: eq (equals), ne (not equals), gt (>), gte (>=), lt (<), lte (<=), in (array contains), nin (not in), exists (field exists)

value.description: Value to compare against (type depends on operator)

dimensions.description: List of scoring dimensions with weights

name.description: Unique name for this scoring dimension

weight.description: Weight for this dimension (all weights should sum to 1.0)

itemField.description: Field name in item document to use for scoring

profileField.description: Optional profile field name (for comparative operations)

operation.description: Scoring operation: normalize (scale to 0-1), price_fit (budget alignment), array_includes (profile array contains item value), exact_match (binary 0/1), similarity (string/vector similarity)

normalizeMax.description: Maximum value for normalization (required if operation is 'normalize')

normalizeMin.description: Minimum value for normalization (optional, defaults to 0)
